subject: Billing consolidation after Nimbus acquisition — remit & invoice reissues
messages:
From: Maya Ramesh <maya.ramesh@nimbushealth.com>

Cc: Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@nimbushealth.com>, AP Invoices <ap-invoices@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps — billing consolidation & remit details after Nimbus/Carelytics close

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for working with us through the transition. Nimbus Health closed the acquisition of Carelytics on 2027-03-01 and we need to consolidate billing under the acquiring entity. To avoid interruptions to payment processing, can Redwood update the billing records and reissue a few recent invoices under the new legal name?

New billing details (effective immediately):
- Legal entity: Nimbus Health, Inc.
- Billing address: 4100 Meridian Ave, Suite 1200, Redwood City, CA 94063
- Remit email: ap-invoices@nimbushealth.com
- US EIN: 94-3216789
- EU VAT (if applicable): EU123456789

We’d like Redwood to:
1) Reissue invoices INV-2026-0897, INV-2026-0954, and INV-2027-0018 to Nimbus Health, Inc. with the new remit address and tax IDs.
2) Update the billing contact to ap-invoices@nimbushealth.com and the credit card/ACH routing if needed.
3) Confirm whether you require a signed PO or W-9 to complete the reissue. Our procurement will attach a PO.

I attached the signed PO (Nimbus_PO_45823.pdf) and looped in Carlos (CFO) and AP. Please let me know the next steps and whether you need a short call to confirm bank remit/ACH details.

Best,
Maya Ramesh
Director, Procurement | Nimbus Health
maya.ramesh@nimbushealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: Nimbus_PO_45823.pdf (application/pdf, 58 KB)

From: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Maya Ramesh <maya.ramesh@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps — billing consolidation & remit details after Nimbus/Carelytics close

Hi Maya — thanks for the note and for sending the PO. Congrats on the close.

Short answer: we can do the reissue and update the remit details, but finance needs a couple of items to process the change cleanly:
- Signed PO (we have the PDF you attached — thanks).
- A completed Billing Change Form (we use this to capture legal name, tax ID, and effective cutover date). I’ve attached a fillable form (BillingChangeForm.pdf) — please sign and return.
- For US tax documentation: a W-9 for Nimbus Health, Inc. (or equivalent) OR a copy of the company’s EIN confirmation.
- Confirmation of the preferred payment method for future invoices (ACH or wire); if ACH, please provide bank remit instructions or confirm we can keep the existing card on file.

Next steps I propose:
1) You complete and return BillingChangeForm.pdf and W-9.
2) Laura in Finance will prepare reissued invoices and update the billing record.
3) We send a DocuSign addendum to formalize the legal entity change for our records (this is standard).

Marissa — looping you in to coordinate any credit/collections items and to schedule a 20–30 min call with the Nimbus AP team if they prefer.

Maya — if you’d like, we can do the call tomorrow afternoon PST; otherwise the paperwork route is fine.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Account Lead, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

Attachment: BillingChangeForm.pdf (application/pdf, 120 KB)

Hi Maya — Laura from Finance here. Apologies for the short delay — we needed to validate the EIN and check our remittance workflows.

Per our finance checklist, we can reissue the three invoices to Nimbus Health, Inc. once we receive:
- Completed BillingChangeForm.pdf (signed).
- Company W-9 or official EIN confirmation.
- Confirmation that the PO (Nimbus_PO_45823.pdf) should be applied to INV-2027-0018 only, or to all three invoices (please advise).

Assuming we get those documents by EOD Monday 3/22, target timeline: reissued invoices will be available within 3 business days after we receive the paperwork. We will also send a DocuSign link for an addendum to formally update our billing records; please sign that to complete the record.

Note on VAT: you listed an EU VAT ID. If Nimbus will be billed from our EU entity for any EU usage, we’ll need local VAT registration proof. Please confirm scope (US-only billing vs. EU-billed workloads).

I created an internal ticket: FIN-2027-3321, and attached the DocuSign link here: https://www.docusign.com/link/XYZ-ADDENDUM-2027.

Attachments we will send when reissuing: reissued_INV-2026-0897.pdf, reissued_INV-2026-0954.pdf, reissued_INV-2027-0018.pdf.

If you want the call, I’m available Fri 3/19 9am PST. Otherwise paperwork is fine.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
